# firebase_storage

**Tag**: firebase, storage, upload, download, files, mobile

## 简介

Flutter plugin for Firebase Cloud Storage, a powerful, simple, and cost-effective object storage service for Android and iOS.

## 官网

- 主页: https://firebase.google.com/docs/storage/flutter/start
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/firebase/flutterfire/tree/main/packages/firebase_storage/firebase_storage
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/firebase_storage
